notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
[h2][b]Mark the date.[/b] [b]Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd.[/b] [i]A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.[/i][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Elylah returns[/b] — wounded, radiant, and relentless. Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures. And you are not ready.[/p][p]This new installment brings:[/p][list][*][p]Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.[/p][/*][*][p]A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.[/p][/*][/list][p]The fugue is a spiral. You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend. [/i] [i]The stage is set. The curtain trembles.

notes.title: Dreamscapes of Delights — Explore the Deepest Layers of the Oniric Realm
notes.content:
[h2] “Dreamscapes of Delights” is not just a chapter [/h2]
[h1]— it’s a turning point.[/h1]
 Step into the longest and most visually rich entry in the Enygmage saga, where Elylah joins Vulpes, Druina, and Phantasia to unravel the mysteries threatening the dreamworld.

 This game doubles the content of previous titles and introduces new areas, daemons, and dramatic choices that reveal the full scope of the universe.
Players have called it the “true beginning of the myth” — and it’s now available for 50% off.

 Includes an abundance of original artwork, animated scenes, secret paths, and multiple endings.
And for fans of lore, this is where maps are revealed, cults emerge, and Elylah earns her title.

 If you’ve been dreaming of a richer experience — now is the time to wake up inside it.

[i]You may also notice something unusual in this announcement...[/i]
Some details, lines, and visual fragments not yet seen before.

These are early echoes of what’s to come.
[h3]A new journey is unfolding beyond Dreamscapes.[/h3]
Something darker, more intimate, and utterly hypnotic.
The fugue has begun — and Elylah is not alone.

 Also... For those who’ve been longing to hold the dream in their hands,
[h3]a special illustrated collection is nearing completion.[/h3]
Soon, you won’t just play Dreamscapes — you’ll be able to explore its essence in stillness.

 Stay tuned. The composition continues...
